applies_why: The judge compares the challenger's seed/loins chain against the defender's chain at D6 vs C1, so it is deciding a chain-against-chain collision.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: 'by footing, never verse by verse' — either footing may consider whether the chain explicitly names Joseph, or footing must assess support without requiring the chain to name it word for word.
why: The judge calls the challenger's chain footed yet treats its failure to name Joseph as a reason for underdetermination, which is a verse-by-verse/stating-claim test rather than chain-vs-chain footing.
